data.name: Kritical McCoy
data.detailed_description:
This journey portrays the uprising of UWirrld Entertainment Recording Studio and more specifically it's owner King Keith.

While seemingly a hip-hop A&R, Manager and Studio owner who signs indie artists and increasing revenue from releasing music and gaining fame, King Keith also hides a secret within that could not only destroy his legacy, but also parts of this world. That secret is Kritical McCoy!

From unknown realms, Krtical McCoy emerges to protect his investments in UWirrld HQ and Earth itself, from urban street foes and unseen spiritual threats, called Entities.

Entities are everywhere! Although unseen by regular humanity, they are within every heated debate, theft, cheat, argument, threats...everywhere. However, being that they are attuned to Earth and Kritical McCoy is not, he can see these entities and obliterate them as well. Although, his mission isn't exactly to "save humanity" but more about saving his empire, with becoming a hero more of an unexpected result.

Some of the features Kritical McCoy may encounter during his journey are:

UWirrld HQ - Your building of operation for hiring new talent, releasing new music and upgrading KM Skills

Open Map - Cross the map at your own leisure and find POI like Da Brickz, Army Base and Boss Fights

KritiCycle - Once unlocked spawn your bike anywhere and cross the map with ease

Transformation - Once unlocked King Keith can enter KM State where he and his bike will transform and become more powerful, faster and...pretty dope

Buy Stuff - Buy weapons, healing items, boost and smoke to keep yourself in good spirits and health

Weapons - Beyond KMs own skills, there are also various melee and ranged weapons at your disposal

So, take the journey along with King Keith and grow your empire all while protecting your assets and, with the help of Kritical McCoy, diminishing the entities ruining not only the world, but your business most importantly!

data.short_description: Grow a hip-hop empire by day, battle unseen Entities by night. As King Keith—and his alter ego Kritical McCoy—build UWirrld HQ, sign artists, upgrade skills, unlock transformations and weapons, and dominate an open world where saving your business may just save the Earth!

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 6-core 3.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
